name: Flatterer's Embrace
descriptionTemplate: [{Devour}: Restore [Arg4]% of lost HP. Dispel self {Vulnerable} state.] Restore [Heal:Arg1] HP. Obtain [Power:Arg2] {STR}.
lore:
When the flatterer begs, don't gloat.
When the flatterer stares, don't blush.
When the flatterer embraces, don't evade.
The flatterer's thoughts and actions lead to one end, where there's no place for you, only a tide of sorrow and downfall.
